metadata.question: Did the water extent in Sebkha el Melah (29.135547, -1.187011) increase between August 12, 2024, and September 29, 2024?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Primary: Sentinel-1 GRD (radar, cloud-free), IW mode, VV. Date windows ±10 days around 2024-08-12 and 2024-09-29; if empty, widen to ±30 days. If either date still empty for S1, fallback to Sentinel-2 SR (cloud-masked) with the same window logic.
   - Location: Point at (29.135547, -1.187011), buffer 15 km.
2. Masking strategy:
   - Sentinel-1: Not cloud-affected. Water mask via VV dB < -17.
   - Sentinel-2 fallback: QA60 + SCL cloud/shadow mask; NDWI > 0.1 for water.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error:
   - Check collection size. If zero after fallback windows: C1.
   - Compute valid pixel counts (count of unmasked pixels). If 0 after masking: C2.
   - If area result is null/NaN: C3.
   - Otherwise compare areas; if Sep > Aug by > 1.0 km², output A; else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

function getInfoAsync(obj) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    obj.getInfo((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v)));
  });
}

function s1WaterAnalysis(dateStr, roi, winDays) {
  const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
  const start = date.advance(-winDays, 'day');
  const end = date.advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
  let col = ee
    .ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S1_GRD')
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .filter(ee.Filter.eq('instrumentMode', 'IW'))
    .filter(ee.Filter.listContains('transmitterReceiverPolarisation', 'VV'))
    .select('VV');

  const size = col.size();
  const mosaic = ee.Image(col.median());
  const vvDb = mosaic.log10().multiply(10).rename('VVdB');
  const waterMask = vvDb.lt(-17);
  const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area');
  const validCount = mosaic.select('VV').gt(-1e6); // count all existing VV pixels
  return {
    method: 'S1',
    winDays: winDays,
    colSize: size,
    validPx: validCount.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('VV'),
    waterKm2: areaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area'),
    cloudPct: null // not applicable for S1
  };
}

function s2WaterAnalysis(dateStr, roi, winDays) {
  const maskS2 = function (img) {
    const qa = img.select('QA60');
    const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10;
    const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11;
    const qaMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0));
    const scl = img.select('SCL');
    const sclMask = scl.neq(3).and(scl.neq(8)).and(scl.neq(9)).and(scl.neq(10)); // exclude shadows/clouds
    return img.updateMask(qaMask.and(sclMask));
  };
  const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
  const start = date.advance(-winDays, 'day');
  const end = date.advance(winDays + 1, 'day');
  let col = ee
    .ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
    .filterBounds(roi)
    .filterDate(start, end)
    .map(maskS2)
    .select(['B3', 'B8'], ['green', 'nir']);
  const size = col.size();
  const mosaic = ee.Image(col.median());
  const ndwi = mosaic.expression('(g - n) / (g + n)', { g: mosaic.select('green'), n: mosaic.select('nir') }).rename('ndwi');
  const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.1);
  const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area');

  const validMask = ndwi.mask(); // non-cloud/non-null pixels
  const validCountImg = ee.Image(1).updateMask(validMask);
  const totalCountImg = ee.Image(1); // all pixels regardless of mask

  return {
    method: 'S2',
    winDays: winDays,
    colSize: size,
    validPx: validCountImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant'),
    totalPx: totalCountImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('constant'),
    waterKm2: areaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
      geometry: roi,
      scale: 1000,
      maxPixels: 1e9
    }).get('area')
  };
}

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const lon = -1.187011;
    const lat = 29.135547;
    const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]);
    const roi = point.buffer(15000); // 15 km buffer
    const dateA = '2024-08-12';
    const dateB = '2024-09-29';

    console.log('AOI: Sebkha el Melah (15 km radius)');

    // Attempt Sentinel-1 for both dates
    let resA = s1WaterAnalysis(dateA, roi, 10);
    let resB = s1WaterAnalysis(dateB, roi, 10);

    let sizeA = await getInfoAsync(resA.colSize);
    let sizeB = await getInfoAsync(resB.colSize);

    // If any S1 window empty, widen to ±30 days
    if (sizeA === 0) resA = s1WaterAnalysis(dateA, roi, 30);
    if (sizeB === 0) resB = s1WaterAnalysis(dateB, roi, 30);
    sizeA = await getInfoAsync(resA.colSize);
    sizeB = await getInfoAsync(resB.colSize);

    let method = 'S1';
    let usedWinA = resA.winDays;
    let usedWinB = resB.winDays;

    // If still empty for either, fallback to Sentinel-2 for both
    if (sizeA === 0 || sizeB === 0) {
      method = 'S2';
      resA = s2WaterAnalysis(dateA, roi, 10);
      resB = s2WaterAnalysis(dateB, roi, 10);
      sizeA = await getInfoAsync(resA.colSize);
      sizeB = await getInfoAsync(resB.colSize);
      if (sizeA === 0) resA = s2WaterAnalysis(dateA, roi, 30);
      if (sizeB === 0) resB = s2WaterAnalysis(dateB, roi, 30);
      sizeA = await getInfoAsync(resA.colSize);
      sizeB = await getInfoAsync(resB.colSize);
      usedWinA = resA.winDays;
      usedWinB = resB.winDays;
    }

    // Case C1: Empty Collection for one or both points after recovery attempts
    if (sizeA === 0 || sizeB === 0) {
      console.log(`Images A:${sizeA} B:${sizeB}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection (No images found in date/location for one or both points).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing & Counts
    const validA = await getInfoAsync(resA.validPx);
    const validB = await getInfoAsync(resB.validPx);

    // For S2, compute cloud %
    let cloudA = null;
    let cloudB = null;
    if (method === 'S2') {
      const totalA = await getInfoAsync(resA.totalPx);
      const totalB = await getInfoAsync(resB.totalPx);
      cloudA = totalA && totalA > 0 ? (100 * (1 - (validA / totalA))) : null;
      cloudB = totalB && totalB > 0 ? (100 * (1 - (validB / totalB))) : null;
    }

    // Case C2: No valid pixels after masking
    if ((validA === 0) || (validB === 0)) {
      console.log(`${method} A ±${usedWinA}d imgs:${sizeA} valid_px:${validA}${cloudA !== null ? ` cloud%:${cloudA.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
      console.log(`${method} B ±${usedWinB}d imgs:${sizeB} valid_px:${validB}${cloudB !== null ? ` cloud%:${cloudB.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels after masking.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Water area calculation
    const areaA = await getInfoAsync(resA.waterKm2);
    const areaB = await getInfoAsync(resB.waterKm2);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const invalidA = areaA === null || !isFinite(areaA);
    const invalidB = areaB === null || !isFinite(areaB);
    if (invalidA || invalidB) {
      console.log(`AreaA:${areaA} AreaB:${areaB}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure (invalid area).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`${method} A ±${usedWinA}d imgs:${sizeA} valid_px:${validA}${cloudA !== null ? ` cloud%:${cloudA.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
    console.log(`A water_km2:${areaA.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${method} B ±${usedWinB}d imgs:${sizeB} valid_px:${validB}${cloudB !== null ? ` cloud%:${cloudB.toFixed(1)}` : ''}`);
    console.log(`B water_km2:${areaB.toFixed(2)}`);

    const diff = areaB - areaA;
    console.log(`Δ water_km2:${diff.toFixed(2)}`);

    const threshold = 1.0; // km^2 to avoid noise at 1 km scale
    if (diff > threshold) {
      console.log('A: Yes');
    } else {
      console.log('B: No');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    // Collection/band names error, syntax/memory issues, etc.
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
